title: How one remark becomes part of your profile
mechanism: A hook logs the style remark you type, and when the turn ends another hook has a forked helper fold it into the profile every session loads.
claim: Say how you write once, and it becomes a line in the profile that every later session loads.
implication: The profile changes by revising lines, not piling them up, so it stays under budget and every edit can be undone from the changelog.

entities.label: Stop hook
entities.note: once a session, hourly at most

beats.title: You say it once
beats.plain: You tell Claude a draft sounds too formal.
beats.technical: UserPromptSubmit runs prompt-submit.mjs; detect() matches "too formal" against PATTERNS.

beats.title: Written down
beats.plain: A hook writes the remark down and tells Claude to honor it in this reply.
beats.technical: append() adds {label, phrase, prompt_excerpt, ts} to observations.jsonl; additionalContext asks for it now.

beats.title: The turn ends
beats.plain: When Claude finishes, a second hook finds the remark not yet folded in.
beats.technical: stop.mjs reads pending(), then checks refine-disabled, the session flag and the one-hour last-refined stamp.

beats.title: A helper forks
beats.plain: Instead of ending, Claude forks a helper that carries the whole conversation, not only the remark.
beats.technical: stop.mjs prints {decision: "block"}; the reason asks for a forked sonnet subagent to run refine-profile.md, which prefers the conversation over the excerpt.

beats.title: One line changes
beats.plain: The helper rewrites one line of your profile, keeping it at 52 lines, and logs the old and new wording.
beats.technical: The subagent revises a line of ~/.claude/rules/write-like-me.md in place; over BUDGET (60) it merges or evicts a line. It appends old and new to changelog.md.

beats.title: Folded in
beats.plain: The helper deletes the remark it used and reports the change to you. Nothing asks first; review can undo it.
beats.technical: The subagent deletes observations.jsonl; its final message, quoting old and new, is the closing summary. /write-like-me:review reverts.

beats.title: From now on
beats.plain: The next session starts with the new line already in its instructions.
beats.technical: Claude Code loads ~/.claude/rules/ into every session and after a compaction; no hook prints it.
